Proof in the paper: The XRD patterns at room temperature (R.T. at the bottom of Figure 4a) indicate that the as-prepared FeK/NC and FeCoK/NC are composed of Fe3O4 and metallic Fe as the main components. However, in the case of FeK/Co–NC, an Fe–Co mixed oxide (CoFe2O4) and a mixed carbide (Co2FeC) were found to initially form. This is in accordance with the TEM-EDS observation (Figure 3), showing a high degree of Fe–Co alloy formation.
